_comment: Merged config for /seo. Written once by references/foundation.md §1 and never overwritten. Real configs drift from this template — add keys where they fit the file you found, never reshape an existing config to match this shape. null means 'not detected yet, fill on first need'.

site.name: SocialsForAI
site._comment_aliases: Brand name variants an answer engine or a mention search might use, including the misspelling you keep seeing.
site._comment_repo_kind: This repo packages the agent SDK/CLI/plugins. The marketing website (socialsforai.com) is a separate codebase — not present here. Health diff and sitemap read the live site.
site._comment_sitemap_url: The live sitemap URL. scripts/health_diff.py --sitemap reads this every run; stack.sitemap_path is null because the site generator lives in a separate repo.

stack._comment_kind: The marketing site stack is unknown — website code is in a separate repo. This repo is Node.js ESM (SDK, CLI, AI SDK, Python client). Degraded to markdown fallback for any content operations.
stack._comment_sitemap_path: null — sitemap generated by the separate website repo. The live URL above is the read target.
stack._comment_llms_txt_path: Site has llms.txt at https://socialsforai.com/llms.txt but it is not in this repo.
stack._comment_content_store: Website content is managed in a separate repo. This repo contains only SDK/CLI/plugin packaging files. No content surface to write to here — file repair and create actions require access to the website repo.

figure_style._comment: Auto-detected visual recon. Not applicable — no website source in this repo.
figure_style.notes: Website repo not present. Infer from live site when needed.

gsc._comment: Search Console not connected to this OpenSEO project. Connect at the OpenSEO dashboard to unlock per-page click/impression/CTR data and URL inspection. First run: says so once, then carries on.
